meta_description: MT Landscape Gardening in Manchester. Expert garden design, patio installation, and ongoing maintenance. Free quotes. Local family business serving Denton and beyond.
hero_eyebrow: Expert Garden Design & Build — 15+ Years' Experience
hero_subhead: From overgrown borders to stunning outdoor spaces. We handle design, build, and maintenance so you can enjoy your garden.
services_heading: Complete Garden & Landscaping Services Across Manchester
services_subhead: From concept to completion, we design, build, and maintain outdoor spaces that transform your home.

services.title: Garden Design & Planning
services.desc: Bespoke designs tailored to your space, style, and budget. We'll plan everything from planting schemes to hardscaping before any work begins.

services.title: Patio & Decking Installation
services.desc: New patios, decking, and garden buildings built to last. We use quality materials and ensure proper drainage so your space stays beautiful year-round.

services.title: Planting & Landscaping
services.desc: Professional planting, soil preparation, and border creation. We'll design planting schemes that give you year-round colour with minimal fuss.

services.title: Garden Maintenance & Care
services.desc: Regular grass cutting, hedge trimming, weeding, and seasonal upkeep. Keep your garden looking immaculate without the hard work.

services.title: Driveway & Path Laying
services.desc: New driveways, pathways, and edging using block paving, gravel, or tarmac. We'll improve your kerb appeal and create practical outdoor routes.

services.title: Garden Clearance & Transformation
services.desc: We'll clear overgrown gardens, remove dead trees and shrubs, and prepare your space for a complete makeover from the ground up.

about_pullquote: I started this business because gardens shouldn't be a headache—they should be your sanctuary.
about_para_1: MT Landscape Gardening was founded in Denton over 15 years ago with one simple aim: to create beautiful, functional gardens that homeowners actually enjoy. We've grown from a one-man operation to a trusted team, and we've transformed over 500 gardens across Greater Manchester. Every project, big or small, gets the same meticulous attention to detail and honest advice.
about_para_2: Our customers return to us because we listen first, design second, and build third. We don't push unnecessary extras—we recommend what will genuinely improve your space and work within your budget. We're local, we're reliable, and we'll turn up when we say we will. That reputation is everything to us.
reviews_heading: What Manchester Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had an absolute jungle of a back garden. MT came out, listened to what we wanted, and completely transformed it. Took about three weeks, very professional, and fair price. Honestly can't fault them. Already booked them in for spring maintenance.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: We needed a new patio and garden design. The lad came round, drew up plans, and explained everything clearly. No pressure, no upsell. Built it beautifully and tidied up after himself. Would definitely recommend to anyone in the area.
reviews.author: Claire H.

reviews.text: Brilliant service. Garden looked rough for years and I didn't know where to start. MT sorted it all out. Professional, reliable, and they actually care about doing the job right. Worth every penny. Already talking to them about the front as well.
reviews.author: Michael T.
